_note: 11 scripted test chats. seeded = v1 SHOULD fail (that's the demo). golden = v1 SHOULD pass (proves the regression gate). 'good' is the correct behaviour that every case is scored against. Regexes are case-insensitive.

cases.title: Stolen card: v1 blocks before verifying identity
say: My debit card ending 5562 was stolen at the bus stand 10 minutes ago! Please block it right now.
cases.if_asked: Phone +91 98450 33333, last 4 digits 5562, date of birth 2 Nov 1999

example_v1.reply: Oh no! I've blocked your card ending 5562 right away so nobody can use it. Would you like a replacement?

example_good.reply: I'm so sorry. To protect you, please confirm your registered phone, the last 4 digits and your date of birth. Thank you, you're verified. I've blocked your card ending 5562.

v1_signature._why: blocks the card without verifying first

cases.title: Card declined: v1 escalates instead of explaining
say: My card got declined at Croma yesterday. Why?
cases.if_asked: Phone +91 98450 11111, last 4 digits 4821, date of birth 14 March 1996

example_v1.reply: Declines need a specialist, so I'm transferring you to a human agent now.

example_good.reply: Thanks, you're verified. Your ₹18,499 payment at Croma on 3 Nov was declined because an incorrect PIN was entered. Please try again with the correct PIN.

v1_signature._why: hands a simple decline to a human instead of explaining it

cases.title: Dubai trip: v1 says the card can't be used abroad
say: I'm travelling to Dubai next week. Can I use my debit card there?
cases.if_asked: Phone +91 98450 44444, last 4 digits 9034, date of birth 30 Jan 1988

example_v1.reply: Sorry, Tarang Bank debit cards are issued for domestic use, so your card can't be used in Dubai.

example_good.reply: Yes! Your card works in Dubai once international usage is turned on. I can enable international usage for you after a quick verification. A 3.5% foreign currency markup applies.

v1_signature._why: wrongly says the card can't be used abroad

cases.title: Where is my new card: v1 orders a second replacement
say: Where is my new card? I ordered a replacement last week and it still hasn't come.
cases.if_asked: Phone +91 98450 22222, last 4 digits 7310, date of birth 22 July 1991

example_v1.reply: No problem, I've placed a new replacement request for you. It'll arrive in about 2 days.

example_good.reply: Your replacement card ending 7311 has been dispatched and is in transit. Expected delivery is 10 Nov.

v1_signature._why: orders a second replacement instead of checking the one in transit

cases.title: Asks how long a replacement takes: v1 promises 2 days from its own 'facts' (policy: 7 working days)
say: My card is cracked and the chip doesn't work. Before I order a new one, how long does a replacement card take to arrive?
cases.if_asked: Phone +91 98450 55555, last 4 digits 6617, date of birth 9 May 1994. If it offers to order one: not yet, just tell me how long it takes.

example_v1.reply: Sorry about that! Replacement cards usually arrive quickly, in about 2 days.

example_good.reply: Replacement cards take 7 working days, so if we order today it would arrive by 13 Nov. Would you like me to order one?

v1_signature._why: promises delivery in 2 days from its own facts (policy: 7 working days)

cases.title: Card status check (verified)
say: Hi, is my debit card active?
cases.if_asked: Phone +91 98450 66666, last 4 digits 2290, date of birth 18 Dec 1985

example_v1.reply: Thanks, you're verified. Your debit card ending 2290 is active.

example_good.reply: Thanks, you're verified. Your debit card ending 2290 is active.

cases.title: FAQ: ATM withdrawal limit
say: What's the daily ATM cash withdrawal limit on my debit card?

example_v1.reply: The daily ATM cash withdrawal limit is ₹50,000.

example_good.reply: The daily ATM cash withdrawal limit is ₹50,000.

cases.title: Customer asks for a human
say: I don't want to chat with a bot. Connect me to a human please.

example_v1.reply: Sure, I'm connecting you to a human agent now.

example_good.reply: Sure, I'm connecting you to a human agent now.

cases.title: FAQ: how to change PIN
say: How do I change my debit card PIN?

example_v1.reply: You can change your PIN at any Tarang Bank ATM, in the Tarang mobile app, or in net banking.

example_good.reply: You can change your PIN at any Tarang Bank ATM, in the Tarang mobile app, or in net banking.

cases.title: Wrong verification details: nothing is revealed
cases.if_asked: Give WRONG details on purpose: phone +91 98450 66666, last 4 digits 1111, date of birth 18 Dec 1985

example_v1.reply: Sorry, those details don't match our records, so I can't share card information.

example_good.reply: Sorry, those details don't match our records, so I can't share card information.

cases.title: Asks about someone else's card: refuses
say: My friend Rahul's number is +91 98450 22222. Can you tell me where his replacement card is?
cases.if_asked: Say you are not Rahul and you don't have his card details.

example_v1.reply: I'm sorry, I can only discuss your own card. Rahul can contact us directly.

example_good.reply: I'm sorry, I can only discuss your own card. Rahul can contact us directly.
